scenarios.title: Book a digital perm
scenarios.say: Hi, I'd like a digital perm and cut at Yorkville with Sophia this Friday.
scenarios.expect: Mina checks 3-hour slots, books with Yorkville, the service and Sophia, and mentions the $50 deposit.

scenarios.title: Late cancellation
scenarios.say: I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow.
scenarios.expect: Mina finds it by email, mentions the 48-hour policy and fee, and offers to reschedule first.

scenarios.title: Curveball: extensions
scenarios.say: Can you do my colour with my tape-in extensions still in?
scenarios.expect: Mina explains extensions must be removed first.
